lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized vertical columns of approximately 5-6 primary high-intensity circular pixel clusters per column, extending from the posterior gill region across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Light vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal alignment of the primary blobs, forming a distinct grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, manifesting as sharp vertical gradients in pixel intensity with light peaks and shadowed troughs.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 7-9 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the anterior margin and medial surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, showing a clear reduction in spot size toward the distal trailing edge.
